blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Net foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows to the Philippines rose to a six-month high in July, though investor sentiment remained subdued amid economic uncertainties at home and abroad. Latest data from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) showed FDI inflows outpaced outflows by $689 million during the month, the highest since January’s net […]...
